chunking.tables: Original materialized text, no whitespace normalization or special table preservation; table diagnostics reported separately.
chunking.packing: source-token union for BM25/dense/dense_rerank; unchanged text-transformer outputs; strict ranked prefix and actual cl100k cap

cohort_rule: source_tokens > budget; full and empty controls on all examples; report paired common cohorts for cross-budget comparisons

reader.transport: Vertex online streaming, fixed concurrency 8; all requests record TTFT and completion latency
reader.identical_request_reuse: Only identical query/context/config/seed; never reuse responses across seeds

selection_repeats: Fresh complete deterministic selection; three-seed reproducibility/timing controls. Do not pretend deterministic duplicate masks are independent evidence samples.

uncertainty.nolima_cluster: needle family; keep related placements/haystacks together

reporting: Report native answer metrics separately from evidence retention, incomplete coverage explicitly, and cold/warm compute separately. Use native provider tokens for API cost.

latency_sample.policy: prespecified matched questions; fresh caches per budget; three seed runs; fixed hardware and batch size; separate from cached incremental selection timings
